row.name: Kids Heaven Daycare and Learning Center

occurrences.finding: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children: Two bottles of an unknown liquid were observed in the kitchen on top of the fridge.    Note: The director said they were just bottles of water and wrote water on the bottles.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3407(12))

occurrences.finding: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - installed and maintained according to manufacturer's instructions: The child safety alarm is not being maintained to the manufactures recommendation. The alarm has to be unplugged every night to ensure it does not drain the battery. It also causes the radio to turn on when the keys are not in the ignition.    The alarm did not work properly when the director returned back from the bus run.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - installed and maintained according to manufacturer's instructions (26 TAC §746.5625(b))

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: The infant and toddler rooms have paint peeling from the walls.     In the hallway the air intake vents are visibly dirty with dust and grime.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records: Caregivers/staff was missing the required following personnel information:    1 out of 4 staff did not have proof of education.   1 out of 4 caregiver did not have a notarized affidavit
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: Two children enrolled in care did not have current immunization on file and available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Admission Information: The following information was missing from the children's admission information:     - 1 child did not have the required physician health statement on file and available for review.      - 1 child did not have the required authorization for medical emergency attention information     - 2 children did not have the required public-school information.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §746.603(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The operation did not have a current fire inspection available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional: A child with a diagnosed food allergy did not have a sign and dated food allergy emergency pla by the parent or the physician.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)

occurrences.finding: Health Statement on File within 1 Week of Admission: Two children's files out of 8 reviewed are missing the health statement for the child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Health Statement on File within 1 Week of Admission (26 TAC §746.611(b))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Transportation training: Transportation training was not observed in the director's file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Transportation training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(7)(A))

occurrences.finding: Documentation PEDIATRIAC CPR-1st aid original certificate on file at center or copy available if licensing requests: Copies of the CPR and first aid were not in the file for the director and two caregivers.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation PEDIATRIAC CPR-1st aid original certificate on file at center or copy available if licensing requests (26 TAC §746.1329(c)(2))

occurrences.finding: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Safe and Sanitary: Two gallons of milk were observed in the fridge past the expiration date of 2/10/25.    Note: These two gallons were dumped out during my inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Safe and Sanitary (26 TAC §746.3317)

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age: The youngest child, 13 months old, is more than 18 months younger than the oldest child in the room at 4 years old.    Note: One child went home leaving the operation to have 12 children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605(1))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - Licensing Parent Notification Poster: The required flyer was not observed posted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - Licensing Parent Notification Poster (26 TAC §746.401(7))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired: Wood boards on the climbing structure are beginning to rot.   The drinking fountain on the playground is falling apart and exposing electrical wires and the motor.  The loose fill area has grass growing.   The loose fill is packed down causing it to not have the shock absorption.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired (26 TAC §746.4751(c))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The fire inspection has not been completed within the 12 months of the previous inspection and not before the current application.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Review list and Remove unsafe products: The CPCS was not observed posted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Review list and Remove unsafe products (26 TAC §746.4135(a))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - Licensing Notice-Keeping Children Safe: The keeping children safe flyer is not posted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - Licensing Notice-Keeping Children Safe (26 TAC §746.401(3))

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: The laminate on the tiles in the school age room are pealing up. The infant room also has cracked tiles near the door.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - List entitled "Current Employees"--sized at least 81/2 X 11 inches, printed legibly, include employee first and last name: A list of current employees in not posted in a predominant place.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - List entitled "Current Employees"--sized at least 81/2 X 11 inches, printed legibly, include employee first and last name (26 TAC §746.401(9))
